The top-secret files that were first leaked on social media websites Discord and 4chan in March this year also caused a flutter for the Joe Biden administration when it revealed confidential and unflattering information about U.S. allies, including South Korea, Israel, and other nations of West Asia and Africa, and assessments of China’s developing cyber-attack capabilities. Potentially most damaging, though, were the leaker’s posts, which, reports said, genuinely contained classified information of the U.S. military, on Ukraine’s air defences being compromised owing to a shortage of missiles in February. Also possibly undermining the tactical plans and the element of surprise for Ukrainian forces were files that spoke of the embattled country’s long-planned spring counter offensive to beat back Russian forces starting on April 30 with 12 Ukrainian brigades. While no explicit propagandistic post of the leaker has been revealed yet, it is obvious that the dots join to paint a clear picture of Mr. Teixeira’s intention to discredit the war effort of Ukraine and its western allies and show up the Biden administration in a bad light amongst its global partners. One thing is clear: Mr. Teixeira is no whistle-blower and, certainly, comparisons to Chelsea Manning or Edward Snowden would be misplaced. The latest leak of U.S. federal government information lacks the moral clarity and ethical underpinning of the WikiLeaks files and the NSA global surveillance exposé that Ms. Manning and Mr. Snowden respectively shared with the world in a bid to highlight the excesses of the U.S. government and spur conversations on human rights, foreign policy and privacy in the digital age. Whistle-blowing in the latter contexts led to introspection, policy dialogue and reforms to bring about greater transparency in U.S. government actions, within limits. The 2023 Pentagon leaks have, contrarily, achieved nothing of this sort but fuelled insecurity between the U.S. and other global powers, and potentially hobbled the war strategies of the Ukrainian armed forces in their bid to fight off Russian troops attacking their country. Mr. Teixeira has, appropriately, been charged for the leaks under the U.S. Espionage Act. The sweltering heat and the scorching sun could never deter his excitement. For him, it was a chance to escape the concrete jungle of the city and venture into the serene and lush green haven of his village. He was especially excited to spend time with his beloved grandmother, whose warm embrace and hearty laughter always filled him with joy. The day finally arrived, and Ramu, accompanied by his parents, boarded a train to their ancestral village. As they reached the outskirts of the village, the bustling noise of the city was replaced with the sweet melodies of birds chirping and the gentle rustle of leaves. Ramu's heart swelled with happiness as he took in the familiar sights of the countryside. Upon reaching their humble abode, Ramu's grandmother stood waiting at the entrance, her arms wide open. He rushed towards her and hugged her tight, feeling her love and warmth envelop him. They exchanged stories of the city and the village, catching up on all that had happened since they last met. In the days that followed, Ramu and his grandmother spent their mornings exploring the verdant fields, the towering trees, and the glistening ponds teeming with life. They would pick ripe mangoes and guavas from the trees, savoring their juicy sweetness. Sometimes, they would join the villagers in their daily chores, tending to the cattle or working in the fields. As the sun dipped below the horizon, Ramu and his grandmother would take leisurely strolls around the village, listening to the soothing sounds of the evening. They would stop by the village square, where the villagers would gather to share stories and laughter. Ramu loved listening to the tales his grandmother told, replete with folklore, wisdom, and the rich history of their ancestors. At night, after a delicious home-cooked meal prepared by his grandmother, Ramu would sit by her side on the charpoy under the blanket of stars. With fireflies dancing around them, his grandmother would recount tales of her own childhood – the games she played, the friends she made, and the adventures she embarked on. These stories would transport Ramu back in time, creating a bond between generations. As the days turned into weeks, Ramu found himself absorbed in the simple pleasures of village life. The warmth of his grandmother's love, the laughter of the villagers, and the beauty of the natural surroundings made the city's chaos feel like a distant memory. His heart was heavy as the summer vacation drew to an end, and it was time to return to the city. Ramu bid a tearful goodbye to his grandmother, knowing that he would carry the memories of this summer vacation in his heart forever. As he left the village with his parents, he looked back one last time, vowing to return the following summer, ready for more adventures and cherished moments with his beloved grandmother. Q42.
